items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: he was playing with Fletcher Henderson... Lewis was lost in that band... Lewis did it. The place woke up

ctx.x: But did you know him in New York you say?

Yes, he was playing with Fletcher Henderson, a band that played strictly arrangements. Lewis was lost in that band. That's why I said, Fletcher, won't you let Lewis do, it don't mean a thing if you ain't got that swing and Lewis, you know. And Lewis did it. The place woke up, they came alive.
What year was that? Do you remember?
